title: Practice is Everywhere (Fall Samish Sesshin talk two)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up two practices that happen outside the zendo, dokusan and oryoki, and turns to Dogen's essay on the tenzo, the head cook. At the center is Dogen's story of meeting the sixty-one-year-old tenzo of Mount Ayuwang on a ship in China, where the old cook buys mushrooms and refuses to stay for tea because tomorrow's meal needs him. Nomon recalls Edie, bent by scoliosis, answering "if not me, who?" when asked to sit down, and thanks Bob Rose as three assistant tenzos take up the ladle. Prajnatara's practice of exhaling without following conditions and inhaling without dwelling leads to tomorrow's Jukai ceremony for six students.
